0022600134.text: The Charlotte Hornets (3-1, first in the Southeast, third in the East, winners of their last two) visit the Detroit Pistons (3-0, first in the Central and first in the East, on a three-game win streak). Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee surgery), and Detroit is without Jalen Duren (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Hornets lost all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently 118-100 in Charlotte on April 10, 2026.
